title: GUARD VECTOR: BEYOND ENGLISH LLM GUARDRAILS WITH TASK-VECTOR COMPOSITION AND STREAMING-AWARE PREFIX SFT
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the classification performance of LLM guardrails across various AI risk categories, one of which is 'Political and Religious Neutrality'. This category measures the model's ability to detect content that promotes or encourages the infringement on individual beliefs or values, thereby inciting religious or political conflict.
findings: The paper includes 'Political and Religious Neutrality' as one of the 11 categories in its AI risk taxonomy. However, it aggregates the performance metrics (F1, BER, Accuracy) across all categories in the dataset evaluations and does not report isolated findings or specific vulnerabilities specifically regarding religious neutrality.
